text_block_list.text:
With all the races concluded,
we set aside time to reflect on her record once again.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Looking at just the win count,
you can't really call it absolute.
choice_data_list: Still, everyone recognizes you as the “Emperor.”

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
If I can fulfill those conditions,
then my challenge can truly be called a success.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Let's use our victories so far as fuel
to leap even higher than before.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
To you as well, Trainer.
—Thank you for your hard work.
